[/b][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077645696045416588/banana-tractor.png[/img]

This was actually my first mod, which I made at my boyfriend's house after he showed me a stupid "banana gun" meme.
This mod changes the appearance of the tractor so that it looks like a giant banana with wheels.


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077643674445430794/how-to-use.png[/img]
[size=2]
To use the mod, you'll first need the Scissors which is sold at Robin's Carpentry Shop, along with the other tools from the Alternative Textures mod. Then all you have to do is click with the scissors on the tractor, and then a menu will appear with all the options for you to choose from, just click on the banana one and the job is done.[/size]
